title: A Greener Street: Weighing the Trade-offs
instructions: 这是为B1水平学习者设计的原创阅读材料（模拟练习，非官方雅思试题）。请先通读短文，理解社区环保方案的取舍。然后完成8道阅读题：单选题、填空题和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。之后学习“第一条件句、because/therefore、情态动词建议”的语法规则，并完成8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
A Greener Street: Weighing the Trade-offs

[A] Last month, the Riverside Community Group met to discuss a plan for Green Street. The plan has three parts: more trees, new bike lanes, and a small garden. The group wants a cleaner and quieter street. However, some people are worried about the cost and the changes.

[B] “If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner,” said Mrs. Chen, the group leader. “Trees also make the street cooler in summer. But we must think about the cost. Each tree costs about 200 yuan, and we need 30 trees. Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.” Mr. Li, a shop owner, said, “If you take away parking spaces for bike lanes, some customers will go to other streets. Because my shop needs parking, I am worried.”

[C] The group also talked about the small garden. “If we build the garden, children will have a safe place to play,” said Mrs. Chen. “But we should ask the children what they want. We could also ask a gardener for advice.” Mr. Li suggested, “Why don’t we keep some parking and add trees only? Then we can have cleaner air and no lost parking.” Another member said, “We must not forget the noise. If we plant trees near the road, the noise will be less.”

[D] In the end, the group agreed on a new plan. They will plant 20 trees and build a small garden, but they will not take away parking spaces. They will ask the children for ideas about the garden. Mrs. Chen said, “We should listen to everyone. If we work together, we will find a good answer.” The group will meet again next month to check the cost.

questions.prompt: What does the plan for Green Street include?
options: More trees, new bike lanes, and a small garden
A new school and a hospital
More parking spaces and a shop
A swimming pool and a library
answers: More trees, new bike lanes, and a small garden
questions.explanation: 原文第一段明确列出计划包括三个部分：more trees, new bike lanes, and a small garden。
questions.evidence: The plan has three parts: more trees, new bike lanes, and a small garden.

questions.prompt: Why is Mr. Li worried about bike lanes?
options: Because the garden is too small
Because the street is too noisy
questions.explanation: 原文中Mr. Li说：Because my shop needs parking, I am worried. 因此他担心自行车道会占用停车位。
questions.evidence: Because my shop needs parking, I am worried.

questions.prompt: How much does each tree cost? (Write one number and one word.)
questions.explanation: 原文Mrs. Chen说每棵树花费约200元：Each tree costs about 200 yuan。填空答案需与原文一致。
questions.evidence: Each tree costs about 200 yuan, and we need 30 trees.

questions.prompt: What does Mrs. Chen say about the garden?
options: Children will have a safe place to play
The garden will take away parking
The garden will make the street noisier
answers: Children will have a safe place to play
questions.explanation: 原文Mrs. Chen说：If we build the garden, children will have a safe place to play。
questions.evidence: If we build the garden, children will have a safe place to play

options: Keep some parking and add trees only
Build a big garden and no trees
answers: Keep some parking and add trees only
questions.explanation: 原文Mr. Li建议：Why don’t we keep some parking and add trees only? 即保留一些停车位，只增加树木。
questions.evidence: Why don’t we keep some parking and add trees only?

questions.prompt: What did the group agree on in the end?
options: Plant 20 trees and build a small garden, but keep parking spaces
Plant 30 trees and take away parking spaces
Build a large garden and no trees
Do nothing and meet again next year
answers: Plant 20 trees and build a small garden, but keep parking spaces
questions.explanation: 原文最后一段说：They will plant 20 trees and build a small garden, but they will not take away parking spaces。
questions.evidence: They will plant 20 trees and build a small garden, but they will not take away parking spaces.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The group will ask the children for ideas about the garden.
questions.explanation: 原文最后一段明确说：They will ask the children for ideas about the garden。因此该陈述为True。
questions.evidence: They will ask the children for ideas about the garden.

questions.explanation: 原文说：The group will meet again next month to check the cost。选项说next week，与原文next month矛盾，因此为False。
questions.evidence: The group will meet again next month to check the cost.

grammar.title: 第一条件句、because/therefore、情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 本课学习三个语法点。第一，第一条件句表示“如果……就会……”：If + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。例如：If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner. 第二，because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。because 引导原因从句，therefore 是副词，前面常用逗号。例如：Because my shop needs parking, I am worried. / We need 30 trees. Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan. 第三，情态动词 should, could, must 用于提建议。should 表示“应该”，could 表示“可以（较委婉）”，must 表示“必须”。例如：We should ask the children what they want. / We could also ask a gardener for advice. / We must not forget the noise. 注意：第一条件句中，if 从句不用 will，主句才用 will。
grammar.example: If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.

questions.prompt: If we _____ more trees, the air will be cleaner.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。因此填 plant。
questions.evidence: If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.

questions.prompt: If you take away parking spaces, some customers _____ to other streets.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句表示将来结果，用 will + 动词原形。因此选 will go。
questions.evidence: If you take away parking spaces for bike lanes, some customers will go to other streets.

questions.prompt: _____ my shop needs parking, I am worried.
questions.explanation: 这里需要表示原因，用 Because 引导原因从句。Therefore 表示结果，不能这样用。
questions.evidence: Because my shop needs parking, I am worried.

questions.prompt: We need 30 trees. _____, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，用 Therefore 表示“因此”。
questions.evidence: Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.

questions.prompt: We _____ ask the children what they want. (建议)
questions.evidence: We should ask the children what they want.

questions.prompt: We _____ also ask a gardener for advice. (委婉建议)
questions.explanation: 表示“可以”的委婉建议用 could。
questions.evidence: We could also ask a gardener for advice.

questions.prompt: We _____ not forget the noise. (必须)
questions.explanation: 表示“必须”用 must。must not 表示“一定不要”。
questions.evidence: We must not forget the noise.

questions.prompt: If we work together, we _____ a good answer.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句用 will + 动词原形，表示将来结果。
questions.evidence: If we work together, we will find a good answer.
